sample_unit: patients with newly diagnosed lung cancer

links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM versus junior oncologists on same guideline-based questions and cases
links.effect: Deepseek-R1 accuracy 92.3%, 87.5%, 85.1% vs junior oncologists 80.4%, 72.8%, 70.2% (P<0.05); overall diagnostic accuracy 94.6% vs 78.9% in 256 cases.
links.quote: In a sample of 256 cases evaluated formally, Deepseek-R1's overall diagnostic accuracy was 94.6%, compared to 78.9% for junior oncologists (P < 0.05).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic, treatment, and ethical judgment accuracy of the Deepseek-R1 LLM compared to junior oncologists on retrospective lung cancer cases, but it does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
